results.title: Merry Christmas
results.overview: A Christmas Eve encounter between two enigmatic strangers sparks a poignant connection - but a dark turn of events threatens to expose their murky past.

results.title: Ta Ra Rum Pum
results.overview: Ace car racer RV and his wife have the world at their feet. But he has an accident and his world is turned upside down. Can he reclaim his lost glory?

results.title: Pardes
results.overview: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his westernised son. He gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter, and brings her to USA. But she shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

results.title: Duplicate
results.overview: Manu, a criminal, finds his doppelganger in a budding chef, Bablu, and uses this fact to his advantage. Later, Manu tries to kill the chef so that he can take over his life and escape the law.

results.title: Chhichhore
results.overview: Following a group of friends from university as they progress into middle-age life and go their own separate ways.

results.title: Shehzada
results.overview: Bantu has grown up suffering his father Valmiki’s vitriolic tongue until he discovers that he’s actually an heir to an influential family, who was exchanged at birth. He moves into their mansion to protect them from a criminal drug lord’s attack and helps the family sort their issues.

results.title: Shaurya
results.overview: Maj. Siddhant Chaudhary, an Indian Army lawyer, attempts to defend Capt. Javed Khan who is accused of killing a decorated officer. The problem is that Khan does not wish to be defended and freely admits to his crime.

results.title: It's Entertainment
results.overview: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

results.title: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
results.overview: A girl from Ambala, Kavya Pratap Singh, is about to be married. When she visits Delhi to shop for her 'dhai lakh ka Ghagra'(wedding dress worth Rs. 2.5 Lakh), she meets Humpty Sharma, a carefree Delhiite, and falls in love with him.

results.title: Band Baaja Baaraat
results.overview: Shruti and Bittoo decide to start a wedding planning company together after they graduate from university, but romance gets in the way of business.

results.title: Sui Dhaaga - Made in India
results.overview: A heartwarming story of pride and self-reliance capturing the journey of Mauji and his wife Mamta, who pursue their passion by overcoming all odds.

results.title: Veer
results.overview: A Pindari Prince goes to England to study military tactics so that he can avenge his people, but while there, he falls in love.

results.title: Humko Deewana Kar Gaye
results.overview: Aditya, an engineer, travels to Canada for training. There he meets Jia, a beautiful woman from an influential family. Fate keeps pushing the pair together, and even though both are already betrothed to others, Adi and Jia fall in love.

results.title: Kabir Singh
results.overview: Kabir, a highly intelligent but short-tempered medical surgeon spirals into addiction after his intense relationship with his girlfriend turbulently ends.

results.title: Munna Michael
results.overview: An expert dancer Munna who idolizes the king of pop, reluctantly tutors a gangster until their developing bond gets disrupted by their common romantic interest towards the same woman.

results.title: Mann
results.overview: A young woman falls in love with a handsome playboy, while aboard a Singapore to India cruise. They make plans to meet again, but fate may have other plans...

results.title: Chandni Chowk to China
results.overview: A cook from Chandni Chowk gets mistaken for the reincarnation of an ancient peasant warrior by the residents of an oppressed Chinese village.

results.title: Tees Maar Khan
results.overview: A con artist poses as a film director in a village with the intention of executing a caper with the unwitting help of the villagers.

results.title: Bad Newz
results.overview: After a whirlwind marriage with social media influencer Akhil Chadha that ends in divorce, chef Saloni Bagga meets hotelier Gurbir Pannu. One night with Gurbir – and then also with Akhil – leads to Saloni getting pregnant. But who's the father? By a one-in-a-billion twist of fate, Saloni is carrying twins – and not just any twins, each child has a different father!

results.title: Welcome Back
results.overview: A pair of reformed gangsters try to find a husband for their newly discovered sister, but complications arise due to mistaken identities.
